description: This is a Java interface named Adapter that defines the contract for mapping objects of type T (which extend Jsonifiable) to and from an Adaptable form, along with supporting methods for retrieving supported groups, channels, criteria, actions, search actions, and response requirements.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object to an object of type T.

methods.name: toAdaptable (overload with T only)
methods.description: Converts an object of type T to an Adaptable using the default TWIN channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable (with T and channel)
methods.description: Converts an object of type T into an Adaptable, specifying the channel used.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns supported groups for this adapter.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns supported channels for this adapter.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns supported criteria for this adapter.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns supported actions for this adapter.

methods.name: getSearchActions
methods.description: Returns supported search actions, defaulting to empty.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates if the adapter is for responses.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates if a subject is required in the topic, defaulting to false.
